domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 用等效线性系统近似非线性随机系统的方法。
usage_overview: 在非线性随机振子的瞬态概率分析中，除用于近似非线性响应外，还可作为其他求解方法的比较基准，并为相关求解提供高斯权函数。

complete_examples.text: The numerical analysis illustrates that the extended EPC method is valid and efficient for achieving the non-stationary nonzero mean PDFs of the responses for the system with strong nonlinearity by comparing the results obtained by extended EPC method, equivalent linearization method and Monte Carlo simulation method.

If the system is under purely additive excitations, Gaussian closure technique is equal to equivalent linearization (EQL) method [4–7], which is one of the popularly used approaches to calculate the response moments of every order or PDF solutions of the nonlinear stochastic oscillators.
